settings.heading: A surprise on repeat
settings.text: Weekly, fortnightly or monthly. Pause, skip, upgrade or cancel yourself — no emails, no phone calls, no awkward retention chat.

settings.footnote: Every plan includes free UK delivery, double loyalty points and first refusal on limited boxes.

settings.heading: Pause or skip
settings.text: Going away? Skip a delivery or pause the whole plan from your account in two clicks.

settings.heading: Change your no-list
settings.text: Update the colours and varieties to leave out at any time — it applies from the next box.

settings.heading: Upgrade or downgrade
settings.text: Switch between weekly, fortnightly and monthly whenever you like.

settings.heading: Cancel yourself
settings.text: One button. No retention call, no hoops. We would rather you came back later.

settings.question: When am I charged?
settings.answer: On the day your box is packed, not before. You'll get an email two days ahead so you can skip if you want to.

settings.question: Can I change my exclusions later?
settings.answer: Yes — update your no-list from your account and it applies to the next box we pack.

settings.question: Can I send it to someone else?
settings.answer: Yes. Add their address as the delivery address, or buy a prepaid gift plan so there's nothing for them to manage.

settings.question: What if I'm not in?
settings.answer: Our boxes are designed to fit through a standard letterbox where possible, and are left in your safe place otherwise.

settings.question: Is there a minimum term?
settings.answer: No. Cancel after one box if you want to.

settings.heading: Start with one box
settings.text: Try a single surprise first. You can always switch to a plan afterwards.
